user.title: Neura Webdialog
user.description: Connect to the heat pump web interface. The integration reads the same schema page as the previous PHP script.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the heat pump, without a path.
data_description.scan_interval: The PHP script was started by cron. 60 seconds matches a run every minute.

mqtt.title: MQTT
mqtt.description: Measured values are published unchanged to the existing topics. Port 1883 and client id neura_webdialog are preset. Enter the broker address yourself.

data_description.mqtt_username: Leave empty when the broker has no login. The PHP script did not send credentials.
data_description.mqtt_password: Only used together with a username.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Neura Webdialog
reconfigure.description: Leave a password field empty to keep the stored value.

error.cannot_connect: The Neura web interface is unreachable.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the username and password.
error.invalid_scan_interval: The interval must be between 10 and 3600 seconds.
error.invalid_port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
error.mqtt_cannot_connect: The MQTT broker is unreachable or refused the login.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured.
